objects.taxonomy_description: Portable chair with collapsible frame. Frame is tubular steel (chrome-plated or painted) or molded plastic. Seat and back are flat panels (wood, plastic, or padded fabric) connected by hinge mechanism. Folded state: flat profile (5-8 cm thick) for storage. Open state: standard chair proportions (seat height 45 cm, back height 80 cm). Cross-brace X-frame provides stability. Seat surface is slightly contoured or flat. Color varies: black, white, beige, or patterned fabric. Hinge points are visible rivets or bolts. Weight is light (2-4 kg) for portability.

objects.taxonomy_description: Swift leporid mammal measuring 45-70 cm body length with elongated body and powerful hind limbs. Fur dense in brown, gray, or seasonal white coloration. Ears exceptionally long (10-15 cm) with black tips. Hind legs massively elongated with muscular thighs enabling rapid leaping at speeds exceeding 60 km/h. Forelegs shorter. Tail short. Young born precocial with full fur coat and open eyes. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, fur insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Timid behavior with cryptic resting posture. Larger than rabbit with longer ears and legs.
